name: io.github.Cassette-Editor/oh-my-cassette
title: Oh My Cassette
description: Video editing through the Cassette agent: import media, edit by chat turn, read the timeline, export

environmentVariables.name: CASSETTE_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit target override; normally use the target saved by oh-my-cassette login.

environmentVariables.name: CASSETTE_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Advanced compatibility override. Normally use oh-my-cassette login and the operating-system keyring.

environmentVariables.name: CASSETTE_FFMPEG
environmentVariables.description: Path to ffmpeg, used to prepare local video before upload (default: from PATH)
